profile.label: Profile setup
profile.subtitle: This helps Nora identify your business and personalize your workspace from the start.
profile.whyMatters: A clear owner profile helps Nora tailor messaging, workspace defaults, and strategic recommendations.

business.label: Business setup
business.subtitle: Nora uses this to understand what you sell, how you position it, and how your business makes money.
business.whyMatters: Business context gives Nora better recommendations for offers, campaigns, pricing, and automation priorities.

brand.label: Brand Identity
brand.subtitle: This helps Nora match your visual style, language, and overall brand presentation.
brand.whyMatters: A consistent identity helps Nora produce on-brand visuals, tone, and positioning suggestions.

audience.label: Targeted Audience
audience.subtitle: Nora uses this to create messaging, content, and campaigns that speak to the right people.
audience.whyMatters: Audience clarity improves copy, hooks, targeting, and the quality of generated growth ideas.

channels.label: Channels & Integration
channels.subtitle: Nora uses your active channels to connect publishing, measurement, and cross-platform recommendations.
channels.whyMatters: Connected channels let Nora align ideas with the platforms where your brand already performs best.

content.label: Content direction
content.subtitle: This tells Nora what type of content to create, how often to publish, and what style to lean into.
content.whyMatters: Content preferences help Nora generate faster ideas that feel native to your audience and channels.

goals.label: Business Goal
goals.subtitle: Nora will prioritize strategy, campaigns, and automation around your primary business outcome.
goals.whyMatters: Clear goals help Nora sort what matters now versus what can wait.

optimization.label: Optimization Inputs
optimization.subtitle: Optional inputs that help Nora learn faster, benchmark smarter, and improve output quality.
optimization.whyMatters: The more context you give Nora here, the more specific and useful future output becomes.

integrate.kicker: Nora tracks and automates your social media
integrate.subtitle: Connect your social media accounts to unlock real-time performance tracking and seamless automation.
